vis.alt: Primary haemostasis: vascular spasm, platelet adhesion by von Willebrand factor binding GPIb to collagen, activation releasing ADP and thromboxane A2, aggregation through GPIIb IIIa and fibrinogen; aspirin blocks thromboxane, clopidogrel blocks the ADP receptor, abciximab blocks GPIIb IIIa.
vis.caption: Adhesion (vWF, GPIb), activation (ADP, TXA2), aggregation (GPIIb/IIIa, fibrinogen); each step has a drug.

vis.alt: Fibrinolysis: tissue plasminogen activator converts plasminogen to plasmin, which digests fibrin into fibrin degradation products including D-dimer; PAI-1 and alpha-2 antiplasmin inhibit it, and tranexamic acid blocks plasminogen binding.
vis.caption: D-dimer rises when cross-linked fibrin has been broken down: it flags clot formation and lysis.
